purpose: Connect finite cell population, remaining agricultural workers, rural meals, seasonal grain collection and the existing SettlementPlan. Implementation/scenario development, not an Earth resident-size fit.
inputs: Current active Earth-atlas raw/corrected published climate, harvest, farm-work, administrative density and settled-reach packets. Reconstruct the existing one-day local foot-collection parent forest and require byte-identical owner IDs before running feedback. No town/track regeneration or climate solve. Never substitute old Nov5 production grids for current r44 inputs.
population: Existing administrative density times the same square cell area is the explicitly assumed origin population envelope. Every land cell remains in the ledger. Only origins in the checked local collection partition may transfer people; others remain rural. This is deliberately different from the earlier wide trade-catchment allowance, and cannot be advertised as a paired gain over it. Same owner for people and grain; no observed population calibration or addition of independent pastoral/forager totals.
food: Current selected single-cereal net edible potential from published kcal/ha, arable fraction, land fraction, FARMED_SHARE and FALLOW. This is the existing partial cereal envelope, not all diets, fertility validation or an empirically complete ancient farm. Rural meals use remaining explicit people at2500kcal/day for365days. No rural-food fraction inferred from grain. Deficit origins export zero; all rural unmet meals remain visible. Positive settlement allocation requires its entire origin catchment to pass rural meal support.
work: Reuse unchanged field_support: workers40% of remaining rural people, annual600 or300hours,30reapingdays,8hours/day, complete listed activities. Reaping is inside annual hours. No free town-worker replacement, labour exchange, draft services or unlisted household work. Work/transfer shares remain scenarios.
collection: Checked frozen local owners and monthly outward/return paths; same first harvest-boundary convention,365day rural/export stores,90day destination stores,5%annual stored-grain loss,10%collection,95%delivery retention,1bin delay. Fixed finite per-site freight upper bound derived once from original potential grain, not walking speed. Keep rural and export stores separate and retain origin-level departures so the full grain ledger can be reviewed.
solver: Each destination has independent origins; no cross-catchment food or people. Evaluate33equally spaced fractions of its admissible maximum resident request, then24feasible/infeasible bracket refinements above the largest feasible sampled fraction. Recompute workers/production/rural meals/export stores/arrivals for EVERY trial. Nonmonotone branches are possible; retain the sampled feasibility curve, refuse unsupported sites and claim only largest certified examined/bracketed allocation, never global optimum. Population, seasonal food, all work bounds and rural-source support are hard constraints. Destination staff/civilians partition the same selected total.
controls: On identical cell populations/owners/work/food inputs, retain the earlier style of destination-only allocation using arrivals frozen at no relocation, explicitly labelled internally inconsistent reference. Zero-transfer worker/food controls and final one-more-evaluation checks. Earlier60scenarios and224placement results remain unchanged.
review: Independent scalar people/work bounds, origin/destination monthly food inventories, per-origin shipments and joint grain balance; zero exports from rural deficits; all positive destination catchments source-supported; exact input/old-atlas hashes; fresh replay. Publish figures in chat and normal atlas evidence. Optional integration must use the SAME SettlementPlan; no defaults or control-adoption claim from numerical accounting alone.
limits_and_next: Cereal-only local supply may leave real modeled rural deficits: preserve them, never reduce population to make a case pass or label missing support empty land. No fresh Earth data, prospective validation, observed urban sizes, migration or staffing calibration. Empirical release2 and complete fantasy release3/4 remain conditional; all actors, unaffiliated/mobile/nonstate and S1-S5 remain on the roadmap. Continue developing after each commit/push.
